## Interfaces

adaptive_artifacts.project adds open_store, StoreBindingError, Binding, and Project with get/list/create/apply; adaptive_artifacts.record holds base_record/now shared with cli. cli _apply_paths resolves root and, without --store, calls open_store and sets args.project/args.store/contract; create/get/apply use _command_project and Project ops; list and other mutators still use _open_store on args.store from _apply_paths. Tests test_open_store.py (R1–R13), test_project_ops.py (R15–R19), test_command_facade.py (R14, R20, R21).

## Assumptions

Graded only from /tmp/aa-library-review-scope.md and read-only inspection of tree at 206fcd0b; ignored execution reports, check-runs, assessments, and assignments as instructed. Did not run pytest. Existing tools/runtime tests were not part of the phase diff but inform prior apply behavior.

## Invariants

open_store resolution order and no-fallthrough on missing meta match project.py and test_open_store.py; package source contains no SE_WORKFLOW_STORE reads (R14); cli path selection no longer uses default_store_path/git-common-dir fallback, aligned with open_store for create/get via _apply_paths; explicit path/env/binding errors do not open alternate stores in tests. cmd apply NDJSON surface no longer matches pre-phase command apply (see findings).

## Conflicts

none
